proposed.text: What is the disciplinary consequence under RA 9266 IRR Section 23 if an architect signs and seals architectural plans not personally prepared by the architect or not executed under the architect's immediate supervision?

options.text: Only an office correction, because sealing is a clerical step
Automatic cancellation of the building permit, which RA 9266 IRR Section 23 does not state
Grounds for suspension or revocation of the Certificate of Registration or Professional Identification Card after notice and hearing
Mandatory hiring of a consulting architect before the Board may consider discipline

rationale.a: Treats the seal as clerical; RA 9266 IRR treats signing and sealing as an accountability act.
rationale.b: Adds an automatic permit consequence not stated in the checked RA 9266 IRR source.
rationale.d: Invents a required corrective step not stated in the checked source.
rationale.correct: RA 9266 IRR Section 23 gives the Board power, after notice and hearing, to suspend or revoke the Certificate of Registration or Professional Identification Card when an architect signs and affixes, or permits the signing or affixing of, the architect's name or seal on work not personally prepared or not executed under immediate supervision.
rationale.takeaway: Keep the consequence tied to Section 23: suspension or revocation exposure after notice and hearing.

proposed.explanation: Source-audited against RA 9266 IRR Section 23; the answer is discipline exposure, not an outdated consequence citation or unsupported automatic-consequence framing.
